overview: The most powerful individuals of modern times FDR, Winston Churchill, Adolf Hitler and Josef Stalin seem to have had no common characteristics except an ambition to lead, a taste for power and a belief that they had been chosen by destiny.
title: Titans of the 20th Century

overview: Luise von Kummerveldt wants to live free from the compulsion and conventions of her noble family and the patriarchal society and work as an author. But as a women in the Wilhelmine kingdom her freedom of action is as tight as her corset. Resignation Suicid? Rebellion? Luise chooses the last one...
title: Haus Kummerveldt

overview: Vika, the wife of a major official, is forced to follow her married to the small Siberian town of Tashtagol, where he is running for mayor. As a result of a family quarrel and a series of comical incidents, she loses her memory, completely forgetting who she is and where she comes from. Vika wakes up in the house of the unsociable forester Mikhail, who is raising three children alone. Taking advantage of the fact that Vika does not remember anything, the children inform her that she is their mother… At the same time, an election race starts in the city, in which the forester unexpectedly finds himself involved. He asks his new wife to help him with the preparation for the elections. The case takes an even more comedic turn when the unsuspecting heroine joins the political struggle against her real husband.
title: Безбашенная

overview: This high-tech series features footage obtained from miniature cameras and endoscopy, ultrasound and X-ray topography that allows viewers to see the links between the inside and outside workings of the body. Each program features a "see through" man and woman that show the complex geography inside the human body. In addition, the programs show how bodily processes affect everyday human lives.
title: Body Atlas

overview: Get in the driver's seat for some of the most extraordinary police chases ever captured on camera -- with never-before-seen footage, it's a fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled window into a world where criminals will do anything to escape.
title: High Speed Chase

overview: Based on events in the early years of the reign of Louis XIV of France, this is the drama of the rumored love affair between the child king's widowed mother, Anne of Austria, and her prime minister, Cardinal Mazarin, as intrigue and political discord ignite the Fronde. The second part of the film also covers the romance between Louis XIV and Mazarin's niece, Marie Mancini.
title: La Reine et le Cardinal

overview: Khloe Wong (Hanli Hoefer), a charismatic but ruthless influencer, engineers a social media scandal to nab a starring role in acclaimed local director Bob Chandra's (Ebi Shankara) highly-anticipated comeback movie. She murders her co-star, pop artist Chris Chan, in self-defense.
title: Khloe

overview: Hoping to revive a dilapidated hotel in the desert, siblings Kat and Randy unknowingly discover that their hotel is actually an erotic oasis for its guests (and staff). Hot Springs Hotel is a playful resort that caters to young, attractive, and amorous visitors. This Showtime comedy is bound to encourage viewers to desire to make a reservation for the Hot Springs Hotel.
title: Hot Springs Hotel

overview: A group of Greek islands in the Aegean Sea home to many archaeological ruins, popular holiday destinations, rugged landscapes and traditional blue and white towns that overlook the sea. Our host, Andi Van Zyl will discover the Cyclades in this three episode series. Starting from Naxos and finishing the journey in Ios,The Cyclades with Andi Van Zyl takes us on a journey to the Greek islands to immerse in their culture, gastronomy and, of course, water sports. Get ready to set sail to this paradisiac landscape with Andi in this exclusive show on Nautical Channel.
title: The Cyclades with Andi van Zyl

overview: The aspiring influencer Liv (Josie Hermer) is sentenced to an offline life by her father because of poor school performance. From the private high school, she also goes back to the Normalo comprehensive school. But Liv has no intention of sacrificing her career for something as trivial as school.
title: Meme Girls

overview: This drama tells the story of Mo Suqing, a seemingly weak orphan girl in trouble, who approaches Ye Zhongjue, the president of the group, to avenge her family, and sets up a scheme step by step. It never occurred to her that the smooth progress of all plans was due to the many routines set up by Ye Zhongjue. The little white rabbit VS the big bad wolf: both sides claim to control the overall situation, but they don't know that there is no hunter in this love game, both of them are prey...
title: Trick in Love

overview: Go Hae Ra worked hard as a merchandiser, but after having a child, she quit her job. For the past 7 years, she put all of her energy into raising her child. She now wants to resume her working career, but she struggles to find a job. One day, she takes an interview for an entry level position at Market House. There, she meets Choi Ji Won, the director of the product planning team who holds the real power at Market House thanks to her charisma and leadership abilities. Go Hae Ra and Choi Ji Won once worked together at another company, so Choi Ji Won decides to hire Go Hae Ra for an intern position in the product planning team. She offers a sweet, but cruel suggestion to Go Hae Ra.
title: Cold Blooded Intern

overview: Through exclusive access to the Vatican archives, this docuseries investigates the controversial history of Pope Pius XII before, during and immediately after WWII.
title: The Pope & The Devil

overview: A film magazine about traditional values. Each issue includes three social and artistic short stories devoted to current topics in Russia and around the world.
title: Вслух!

overview: A staged documentary series featuring several scenes from an alternative history of Russia/USSR from different eras, compared to actual history. The program's host, Alexey Vershinin, is not only a narrator but also a time traveler who, by traveling through time, personally changes the course of events.
title: Альтернативная история

overview: Outside its perimeter is desert and dust, inside,10 players will take on thrilling challenges and complete the levels to defeat the Master of Time. eSports presenter and streamer, Cristinini, will embody this role and monitor the players' progress as they race against the clock. Each level will require great mental and physical skill, and in this competition, time is everything, as at the end of each round, the player with the least amount of it remaining is eliminated.
title: Time Zone

overview: In Fight to Survive, Akbar Gbajabiamila hosts a social experiment in primitive survivalism—with a competitive twist. Seventeen competitors, including former "Survivor," "Alone," "Naked and Afraid," and "American Ninja Warrior" contestants, must survive 25 days on a remote tropical island combatting brutal conditions—and each other—to win $250,000. In one of the most intense survival-of-the-fittest competitions ever televised, the competitors battle one another for essential tools and resources in the fight to survive.
title: Fight to Survive

overview: E! True Hollywood Storyis a documentary series that strives to give its audience the inside scoop on Tinseltown's hottest dishes, ranging from behind-the-scenes tension on hit shows to the real dirt inside a current tabloid scandal. The list of celebrities profiled on the show include Drew Barrymore, Johnny Depp, Robert Downey Jr. and Britney Spears.
title: E! True Hollywood Story

overview: In Battle of the Decades, three teams take on a series of challenges for the chance to make it to the final round. In round one it is all about nostalgia as host Jonathan Bennett reveals the contents of a time capsule which includes mandatory ingredients and a cooking gadget from a particular year that must be used in the first dish. The chefs will have to employ everything from an electric grill to a fondue pot to accomplish their missions. In round two, the remaining teams have to put their own spin on viral food trends like smiley fries and spicy vodka pasta. Then, in round three, the final team standing must face off against each other to create their version of a timeless dish like Chicken Kiev and Beef Wellington, for the ultimate test of the decades. In the end, only one chef will walk away with $10,000.
title: Battle of the Decades

overview: This mouth-watering series will see 10 of Australia's most decorated pastry chefs, chocolate connoisseurs and baking experts whisk it all to be named Australia's first ever Dessert Master. Juggernaut judges Melissa Leong and Amaury Guichon are ready and raring to taste their way through what will be some of the most inventive and irresistible desserts Australia has ever seen.
title: Dessert Masters

overview: Underwater Cinematographer and explorer Dean Cropp is joined by a crew of young adventurers to follow in his father's footsteps on an expedition into the most remote, pristine, and beautiful parts of Australias Coral Sea.
title: Bluewater Safari

overview: Dateline investigates the tragic death of Jill Halliburton Su and the man who escaped custody and nearly got away.
title: Who Killed Jill Halliburton Su?

overview: Around 5000 years ago, one of the largest and most powerful empires in history emerged on the Nile – Ancient Egypt. This mysterious era continues to fascinate us. In eight episodes, this series shows the unique achievements of the ancient Egyptians in government, culture, and society. International scientists and researchers decode the facets of this advanced civilisation. The first territorial state in history was founded more than 3000 years ago – making it older than any nation in existence today. Crises keep dividing the region and causing chaos, and it is these phases that the people on the Nile fear the most. They know that only order and stability can lead to prosperity. Egyptians are given a sense of identity and unity by their diverse cultures.
title: Ancient Egypt: Chronicles of an Empire

overview: Celebrity Rehab with Dr. Drew is the first television series to chronicle the dramatic, unscripted real life experiences of a group of actual celebrities as they make the life-changing decision to enter themselves into a drug, alcohol and addiction treatment program with the sincere desire to achieve true rehabilitation and recovery. This compelling true account of addiction, healing, and redemption is being supervised with great compassion and insight by renowned addiction and recovery expert Dr. Drew Pinsky, Medical Director of the Department of Chemical Dependency Services at Southern California's Las Encinas Hospital, and host of the long-running radio and television advice series LOVELINE". This inspirational journey begins inside one of Southern California's private addiction and recovery treatment facilities, the Pasadena Recovery Center in Pasadena, California.
title: Celebrity Rehab with Dr. Drew

overview: The drama tells the story of Xu Tian, a young man who goes north with a mission to support the revolutionary cause and meets many bloodthirsty and respectable aspirants, allowing Xu Tian to shed his youthfulness and combine his ideals and will.
title: Fearless Blood

overview: Sinai, 2014. Battalion 101 in the Egyptian army wages a ruthless war against the most dangerous terrorist organizations, turning impossible odds into reality.
title: El Kateeba 101

overview: Popularity Papers follows middle-school besties Julie and Lydia as they seek to demystify one of life's greatest questions: what makes someone popular? Every social experiment they test out comes with unexpected lessons about the value of friendship, kindness, and confidence, helping guide our characters through the struggles of middle school with humour and heart.
title: Popularity Papers

overview: In 1976 a group of prisoners from Basauri prison simulates their own escape. No one imagines that they are still inside the prison, digging a tunnel where to escape.
title: Ihesaldia

overview: A team of journalists came to report on the departure of the vacationers at L'Escapade, a small campsite in the Landes. But suddenly, the end of the world seems to arrive, leaving the last vacationers in a total blur. Are they the last survivors of humanity? In front of journalists' cameras, they will try to survive, live together and understand what is happening to them...
title: Dead Landes, Les escapés

overview: A large number of amateur chefs compete in the MasterChef France kitchen to impress three judges in order to become the MasterChef France winner.
title: MasterChef France

overview: Play for Today, an anthology series of plays carrying on in the tradition of its predecessor The Wednesday Play, presented controversial works by such writers as Dennis Potter, David Mercer, Alan Bennett, and Jim Allen, with such directors as Ken Loach, Alan Clarke, Philip Saville, and Mike Newell. Several plays in the series led to various spin-offs, including Play for Tomorrow and Rumpole of the Bailey.
title: Play for Today

overview: Piers Morgan Live (formerly known as Piers Morgan Tonight) is a talk show on CNN that was hosted by Piers Morgan. The show premiered on January 17, 2011, and filled the former Larry King Live timeslot. The theme music was written by Anthony James, composer and CEO of British company Music Candy, and his writing partner Yiorgos Bellapaisiotis, Music Candy's Director. Piers Morgan Live was recorded primarily in CNN's studios at the Time Warner Center in New York City. It was announced on February 23, 2014, that Piers Morgan Live would be canceled; the date of the final show was March 28, 2014.
title: Piers Morgan Live

overview: Paladino is a dentist who fights cavities during the day and crime at night. For that, he will have the support of the clumsy Sérgio, who makes dental prostheses during the day, and of Sheila, his dubious secretary, owner of many facets, known in the square by her various names. The villain of the series is Detective Miller, who will do everything to discover the identity of the heroes. That's because the trio will end up committing crimes and breaking everything else that helps society. Because of this, the lawyer Vera will have to cut a corner to defend the anti-heroes. Also in the series is Eurico, a retired police officer and Paladino's sensationalist father. The hero had a tumultuous childhood relationship and tries to overcome his father, who worked as a police chief, in the fight against crime.
title: O Dentista Mascarado

overview: Battle of the Judges is the newest battleground for Filipino talent. It has four judges who are all prominent entertainment personalities, leading their squad of the best of the best performers to the battle stage to determine who will make it to the end and win one million pesos, and be declared as the first-ever ultimate champion. The judges will mentor and prepare their squad members for the three levels of competition: "Battle of the Best," "Battle to the Top," and "The Ultimate Battle." In "Battle of the Best" (elimination round), the thrilling encounter of 24 squad members of the four judges will fight it out in 12 battles. In "Battle to the Top" (semifinal round), the four judges continue to guide the remaining 12 performers who will face off against each other in six battles. In "The Ultimate Battle" (the final level and championship round), the seven performers from the squads of the four judges will fight against each other to conquer the battle stage and be voted as the one and only Ultimate Champion. The winner for each battle will be based on the votes of the two non-competing judges and 100 studio audience.
title: Battle of the Judges

overview: Ibiza: Secrets of the Party Island will explore how the glamorous party island operates over the course of one summer season. Zara first visited Ibiza in 2019 and fell in love with the Island. Having returned many times since as a holidaymaker, she now wants to discover how it all works from the inside. With unprecedented access and a rich cast of characters, Zara will seek to understand the Ibiza phenomenon and how the island is changing as it looks to attract a more upmarket clientele.
title: Ibiza: Secrets of the Party Island

overview: Dependable Max Lindner and his loutish best mate since childhood Philip 'Fibbes' plan to celebrate graduating from Münich in a Colorado snowboarding camp, but when Max's father Ludwig is incapacitated indefinitely they decide to cancel till further notice to save the Lindner family business, a ski inn in Hochtal, Bavarian Alps (Southern Germany). Then they decide to do even better: behind conservative Ludwig's back they create a snowboarder heaven of their own, 'Powder Park', despite vicious sabotage from the nasty mayor Hubertus Sailer. Besides the business side and the young, sometimes troublesome guests, the studly boys, soon joined by Georg, Sailer's soft-hearted son their age, must also deal with lots of problems in the Lindner family (mainly max's ma's frustration, sister Lindy and her darling 'fatherless' kid-son Florian) and their own bumpy love-lives plus some shorter story lines.
title: Powder Park

overview: For its 10th anniversary, The Voice is starting a season like no other: The Voice: All Stars, a first in the world. An absolutely extraordinary level of competition that brings together the cream of the crop of past Talents in "The Voice" and five historical coaches of the program.
title: The Voice: All Stars

overview: Burke's Law depicted the crime-solving adventures of dashing, debonair swinger Amos Burke, an L.A.P.D. homicide captain who just happened to also be a millionaire. Each week, Burke (a suave, and very eligible, womanizing bachelor) would be faced with a mysterious murder case involving an assortment of colorful suspects (each portrayed by a special guest star, often cast "against type" and getting a chance to ham shamelessly). Burke, upon receiving the inevitable call to the crime scene, usually gave a terse "When? Where? I'm on my way"; then, forsaking his mansion and "date du jour", he would be transported in style by Henry, his Philippine chauffeur/valet/chef/butler. Burke was aided in his investigations by brash young Detective Tim Tilson, who was usually trying to outshine his boss.
title: Burke's Law

overview: A romantic story, set in Rio de Janeiro in the 1940s, which tells the rise of a popular music singer during the golden age of radio. A troubled time, in which major political events are mixed with the glamor of the radio world and its stars.
title: Aquarela do Brasil

overview: The story of how Rose Dugdale went from being an English millionaire's daughter to an avid supporter of the IRA who led the theft of paintings worth £8million in 1974.
title: The Heiress and the Heist

overview: Kubanacan is a small island paradise in the Caribbean. During the 1950s, while the region was shaken by political crises, Esteban Maroto arrived, a man with amnesia who ended up changing the routine of all Kubanaquenses.
title: Kubanacan

overview: It is a story about Raver and Ford, two childhood bestfriend that was separated by fate but will definitely cross paths again however being with each other will not be that easy as they will be played by the ghost of the past and tested by fate, dreams and destiny.
title: A Story to Remember

overview: A series inspired by real events that tells the story of "Operation Condor" and fictionally recounts one of the first claims to Argentine sovereignty over the Malvinas Islands. The operation carried out by some young Argentines who diverted an Aerolíneas Argentinas plane bound for Río Gallegos and made it land in the Malvinas Islands.
title: Cóndor Uno-Cero-Cinco

overview: Though most people associate D-Day with the massive invasion of Normandy on June 6, 1944, a "D-Day" is actually a military term for any amphibious operation, and few theaters during WWII saw as many battles as did the waters of the Pacific, where more than 100 D-Days were waged.
title: D-Days in the Pacific

overview: About a 35-year-old office employee named Mukai-kun, who has been single for 10 years now, and still has a lingering attachment to his last ex-girlfriend, Miwako. At work, Mukai-kun starts to notice Nakatani-san, a temporary employee. Caught between an old flame, he cannot let go, and a new encounter, Mukai-kun starts his "spot the difference" love game.
title: Turn to me Mukai-kun

overview: A story about a group of young people from various educational backgrounds and environments, who fatefully meet at the sea in the middle of summer, and grow up together as they confront with their complex feelings and bottled-up emotions.
title: Manatsu no Cinderella

overview: Burke's Law is a revival of a detective series of the same nam that ran on ABC from 1963 to 1965. The show followed Amos Burke, millionaire captain of Los Angeles police homicide division, who was chauffeured around to solve crimes in his 1962 Rolls-Royce Silver Cloud II. Though the original series was converted from a detective show to a spy drama in its third and final season, the revived series was again a cop show. The Rolls-Royce used in the original 1963–1965 series still exists, and is owned by a collector in Palm Beach, Florida.
title: Burke's Law

overview: "This is historic — literally." At least, that's what a digital Michael Cera says at the start of the trailer for Steven Soderbergh's upcoming sci-fi comedy series, "Command Z." The "Ocean's 11″-through-"13" director has rounded up Cera, Roy Wood Jr., Chloe Radcliffe and Liev Schreiber for a post-apocalyptic look back at the year 2023, as they traverse into the past by putting a wormhole in a washing machine. "Here's the funny part. Traversing our wormhole involves ingesting a synthetic substance related to psychedelics and playing the theme song from the movie ‘Mahogany,'" says the Ozian Cera. He leads Wood Jr., Radcliffe and Schreiber on a series of missions, hacking into the brains of people from 2023 to alter their thoughts and undo history, which in this universe in includes the NRA teaming with police unions and an Amazon-Walmart merger allowing for blood as payment."
title: Command Z

overview: It's the start of the holidays for Hanane, Maissa and Ambre, three inseparable friends who grew up in the same housing estate. The summer will be devoted to first love stories and the transition to adulthood. But when Djamel, Hanane's older brother, is found unconscious, the 3 friends decide to find the culprit of his attack. Between screwed up boyfriends, intrusive parents and threatening drug dealers, Hanana, Maissa and Ambre can only count on their REUSSS.
title: ReuSSS

overview: Sociopath Lika is endowed with an incredible gift to bring good luck in any scam, moonlighting as a kind of "talisman" in criminal circles. But when one of the criminal authorities decides to make Lika his personal talisman, she is forced to embark on an adventure along with Anton, an unfair accountant, who is unjustly accused of money laundering through a charitable foundation. The heroine will try to prove Anton's innocence, as well as restore his relationship with his daughter Stesha.
title: Диагноз «Везучая»

overview: Aspiring fashion designers take on challenges inspired by the Ulster-Scots influence.
title: A Stitch Through Time

overview: Natsume Takumi is a talented architect who runs a design bureau in Tokyo. He is smart, handsome, successful and popular with women. Takumi lives alone in an elite apartment in a multi-storey building. One day, for the first time in many years, he meets his childhood friend Sendo Yae and makes her an unusual proposal... Sendo Yae is single, works in a cafe and shares an apartment with a friend. One day she loses everything: she gets fired from work, the guy quits and, on top of everything else, her friend announces that she is getting married and moving out of the apartment. Unable to pay rent alone, left alone and without a job, Yae finds herself in a desperate situation. At this time, she accidentally meets Takumi, and he offers her for the next six months to get a job with him as a "fictitious wife" with accommodation in his apartment. Takumi, for her own reasons, needs the status of a married man, and Yae, left on the street and without means of livelihood, is forced to agree to the proposal.
title: Our Fake Marriage

overview: Documentary series looking into a controversial period in Welsh history when English-owned second homes were targeted by arsonists.
title: Firebombers

overview: Each episode gives viewers an inside look at television, film and music, including interviews with each industry's biggest stars. Over the years, many celebrities have "broken their silence" regarding various scandals or tragedies with hosts and correspondents from ET. In addition to covering breaking news, the show visits sets of movies and TV shows and heads to the red carpet to cover awards shows and other major events. Airing daily since 1981, Entertainment Tonight is the template by which many other entertainment newsmagazines are based.
title: Entertainment Tonight

overview: The series tells the story of Ubaldo, an unhappy bank clerk in the urban area of São Paulo with no memory of his childhood. He discovers that he has an inheritance and two sisters in the backlands of Ceará: Dilvânia leads a group that adores her famous late father; and Dinorah is the only woman in a gang of bank robbers.
title: Cangaço Novo

overview: This is the story of Doroteo Arango, Francisco Villa, from his beginnings in banditry when he was very young, until his death in an ambush, and portrays the dark Villa, since he was a vandal, his controversial personality that led him to be General Pancho Villa, the Centauro del Norte y sus Dorados, the anti-hero who redeems himself, partly a fiction that he himself paid for and his role in the history of the Revolution. Villa generated hate and love, contempt and respect.
title: Pancho Villa: El Centauro del Norte

overview: The story of a complicated relationship between five heroes who met on a side job in a diner back in their student years.
title: Around 1/4

overview: Steve Backshall dives with great white sharks, hammerhead sharks, tiger sharks and many more, to celebrate the wonder of sharks and dispel the myth of sharks as nothing more than cold-blooded killers.
title: Most Extreme Sharks

overview: 100 вопрос взрослому is a talk show in which an adult hero answers questions from children. Communication is moderated by the presenter, whose voice sounds off-screen. Children's spontaneity, sincerity and lack of fear to ask an uncomfortable question to a famous person - the conversation will turn out to be very bright and interesting!
title: 100 вопросов взрослому

overview: The Soviet Union is dying before our eyes, but with a premonition of change, freedom from conscience appears, bordering on lawlessness. And friendship and concepts of justice are increasingly mixed with violence and crime. Ordinary schoolboy Andrei, in order to be on the side of power, changes piano etudes and solfeggio for Yura Shatunov's hit "Gray Night" and fierce fights in the company of a new friend, school bully Marat. Andrei and Marat are waiting for the first blood, the first love, the first betrayal and the first death. And for someone like Vova, Marat's half-brother, who returned from Afghanistan, a cruel disappointment in ideals and internal restructuring.
title: Слово пацана. Кровь на асфальте

overview: The series covers the victorious trajectories of the men's soccer team in World Cups. In the debut, the controversies in the formation of the 1958 team and the emergence of Pelé.
title: 5x Brasil

overview: Vera has a terrible disease – infertility. Together with her beloved husband Andrey, she goes to a distant secret hermitage, where a certain healer, Father Athanasius, lives. Despite Andrey's skepticism, a miracle happens: Vera is pregnant. But over time, the heroes, without knowing it, find themselves under the influence of a terrible destructive cult, and Andrei must do everything to save his Vera.
title: Последователи

overview: It is a realistic drama that delves into the complexities of a workplace sexual assault case. The story revolves around Zhao Xun (Angelababy), the victim of a workplace sexual assault case that was anonymously reported. Initially, she denies being harmed but five days later, she files a police report accusing rape. Defense attorney Lin Que (Zhou Xun) becomes involved in the case early on, dismantling the victim's accusations one by one with undeniable legal facts, ultimately revealing the truth and bringing the criminal investigation to a close, leading to the withdrawal of the case by the police. The accused, who suffered personal reputation damage and faced the "black swan effect" on their business, successfully clears their name with Lin Que's representation and launches a civil lawsuit against Zhao Xun for defamation. As the details of the case are revealed, Zhao Xun becomes the target of online harassment, facing public shaming, losing her job, and her life spiraling out of control. Caught between the legal facts and her own "subjective truth," Lin Que faces unprecedented ethical challenges in her career. How will she choose?
title: Imperfect Victim

overview: In this restaurant, "seven stars" might not be a good thing... From Ashton Kutcher's Geisha House to Robert DeNiro's Ago, attaching a celebrity's name to a restaurant is definitely a growing trend in Hollywood.... but is it always a recipe for success? Famous Food will put this concept to the test by partnering with renowned restaurateurs, The Dolce Group, to give seven celebrities the chance to turn an empty Sunset Strip eatery into a flourishing and fully operating restaurant. If they succeed -- one of them will be rewarded with a partnership position in the new venture. The cast includes Heidi Montag ("The Hills"), who sees this as her chance to save her family after the demise of her parent's restaurant. Singer (and the former NY Governor's Scandal-Girl) Ashley Dupre will try her hand at a new kind of business. She might not know food but she knows customer service on "Famous Food".
title: Famous Food

overview: Politi gives a look into an everyday life that most people know nothing about. For almost a year we follow police students, incident commanders and the Police's Immigration unit.
title: Politi

overview: NASA Apollo astronaut Neil Armstrong adds to his long list of aviation accomplishments as he takes the controls of a variety of flying machines. Each episode blends historic footage, interviews, and flying. Armstrong takes you on an exhilarating adventure through time.
title: First Flights with Neil Armstrong

overview: Celebrate Southern identity through the eyes of contemporary creators of literature, music, film and TV, among them authors Angie Thomas, Jesmyn Ward and David Joy; poet Jericho Brown; songwriters Lyle Lovett, Tarriona "Tank" Ball, Jason Isbell and Justin Moore; songwriter/actor Mary Steenburgen; songwriter/screenwriter/actor Billy Bob Thornton; and screenwriters Qui Nguyen and Michael Waldron.
title: Southern Storytellers

overview: Nicole and Jacques have eaten a lot of bad cake — and now they're teaching terrible bakers the errors of their ways. Will one of them finally nail it?
title: The Big Nailed It Baking Challenge

overview: A film team accompanies the activists of the environmental protection organisation Greenpeace for a year
title: Inside Greenpeace

overview: How people drive, heat their homes and keep the lights on needs massive change. But what will it take to make it happen?
title: What They Really Mean for You

overview: Janey Godley and daughter Ashley Storrie work on a farm, construction site, in an airport and at a factory, to prove they have what it takes to cut it outside the world of comedy.
title: Janey and Ashley Get a Real Job

overview: The drama tells the story of average workers, who silently work hard on each one's own task. They finally pull together as a team to fight through a difficult and unfair situation. Lee Soo In has the kind of temperament where he has to do the right thing no matter what. After his discharge from the military, he finds work at a large retail market. One day, his boss orders him to fire temporary employees at the store. Lee Soo In refuses to do so and decides to join the labor union. He and the temporary employees struggle against unfair dismissals.
title: Awl

overview: Live action series for pre-school children featuring Sali Mali and friends.
title: Pentre Bach

overview: Swaragini is a story about two families who developed animosity over the years due to a rift created 20 years back. Swara and Ragini are the daughters from each family and also half sisters, which they get to know only once they grow up. The sisters try hard in mending the relations of the families. Lakshya, Ragini ex-fiancé, has started falling for Swara. Will he be able to express it or will keep it hidden? On contrary what will be Ragini's reaction when she knows about the same?
title: Swaragini

overview: What makes a Serial Killer tick? For each of the 10 multiple-murderers featured, Making a Serial Killer offers an answer. America's youngest serial killer thought owning a loud dog was enough to kill one of his victims. One woman claimed she had the right to kill men because of what she had suffered when younger. Reasons given for murder by each killer is forensically dissected in a series with gripping detective stories, heart-breaking first-person reports and interview footage from interrogation rooms as detectives themselves try to understand the actions of the serial killers they sit opposite. We witness the world's first trans-gender serial killer, we witness the probable next victim of a multiple killer released and hear the chilling voice of Connecticut's worst serial killer as he blames his victims for their death.
title: Making a Serial Killer

overview: Cameras follow life-saving operations at the University Hospitals Birmingham.
title: Surgeons: A Matter of Life or Death

overview: The Frontier explores the legends, events and folklore of the American frontier which have embedded themselves into our culture so much so that the Old West, especially the Western genre of films, has become one of the defining periods of American national identity.
title: The Frontier

overview: Since the beginning of time, generations have looked to the moon – it's a place filled with wonder, romanticism and dreams. It commands time, tide and life and has had an astonishing impact on life on Earth. It's spawned countless myths and legends, from werewolves to the belief that a full moon can make you crazy. Now, in this two-part documentary – writer, comedian, amateur astronomer and astrophotographer Dara Ó Briain explores the ways in which the moon shapes just about everything around us and how we are now looking to shape the moon in the future.
title: Wonders of the Moon with Dara Ó Briain

overview: Follow collector Jay Bartlett across North America as he hopes to build the ultimate action figure auction in the name of charity.
title: Action Figure Adventure

overview: In this new dating experiment, MTV will bring the choices and excitement of dating apps to life! Three single best friends will enter a literal "hall" of eligible men, who are all ready to commit. Inside this dating utopia, the women are in control as they search for real love. But they quickly realize having too many ideal choices is harder than it seems. In the end, they'll have to answer the question, "If you're offered everything you want... will you ultimately choose what you need?"
title: The Love Experiment

overview: In the year 2034, the Earth is in a catastrophic state. Thus, the Romano-Fafard, a spaceship commanded by the Capitaine Patenaude, is sent to discover another planet.
title: Dans une galaxie près de chez vous

overview: A journalist who goes after a secret organization that has members from every unit of the state is executed while doing research. Upon this situation, Superintendent Ali investigates the organization while trying to find the perpetrators of the murder. However, in this process, Ali finds himself in a difficult struggle.
title: Şebeke

overview: «League of Cities» is a new humorous project of TNT TV channel and AMiK company, in which teams will compete for the title of Champion of the season and a prize of 10 million rubles. Mentors, humor gurus – Sergey Svetlakov, Marina Kravets, Alexey Shcherbakov and Artem Kalaijyan - will help the teams to win in a serious humorous battle. Each of them will select teams under his wing, with which he will «work» further. 62 teams from 73 cities of Russia, Belarus and Kazakhstan will take part in the first qualifying round. Only half of them will make it to the second round. Next, a stage of battles will take place, in which the teams of each mentor will compete with each other until there are four finalists left in the project. The winner of the season will be determined among them.
title: Лига городов

overview: The young illustrator Xiang Yan, who had just stepped out of the ivory tower and longed for a happy married life, unexpectedly met Lin Hengyu, a successful dentist who had always advocated for celibacy. By coincidence, the two became roommates and, over a long period of cohabitation, Lin Hengyu's icy heart was melted by Xiang Yan's warmth. He gradually realized his love for Xiang Yan, and Xiang Yan also gradually discovered that her desire for marriage was essentially a desire to establish an intimate, trusting relationship with a partner. The two overcame the ups and downs of love and career. Gradually understanding the true essence of love, they finally walked hand in hand into marriage.
title: My Dearest

overview: Actor Harry Lloyd hasn't been in the spotlight since he was killed off in Season 1 of the hit series Game of Thrones. In order to regain his crown he turns to social media, where he finds himself followed by the most Supreme Tweeter. A quirky 3-part web series, with VERY special guests including George R.R. Martin, Maisie Williams and Tamsin Greig.
title: Supreme Tweeter

overview: The travels of four friends-improvisers are not limited to the tour schedule - this time they go on an unexpected trip to the cities of Russia to have a good time and surprise each other. And most importantly, answer the question: "What are we doing? Where we are going?"
title: Чё делаем? Куда идём?

overview: We explore how individual animals, sometimes working together, shape their world in designing and constructing their homes and shelters. In South-East Asia the orangutan has mastered structural design to build their secure sleeping platform every night high in the trees. In southern Africa some weaver birds build the great communal nests that can last for a hundred years. But the master builder of all is the beaver, an aquatic rodent that alters the flow of rivers to shape the world around them.
title: Baumeister der Wildnis
